name: Ned's Atomic Dustbin
description:
'''Ned's Atomic Dustbin''' is an English [[Rock music|rock]] band formed in [[Stourbridge]], West Midlands, in November 1987. The band took their name from an episode of [[radio comedy]] programme ''[[The Goon Show]]''. The band is unusual for using two bass-players in their line-up.

They have been cited as an influence by [[Cap'n Jazz]] and [[Blink-182]].
